mechanism: Potassium elevation increases quinidine toxicity by enhancing myocardial sensitivity to the drug's class IA antiarrhythmic effects and increasing risk of arrhythmias.
action: Monitor serum potassium and quinidine levels closely; maintain potassium in normal range (3.5-5.0 mEq/L); consider potassium supplementation avoidance or dose reduction if co-administered.
